assumptions: A-1  Cost Allocation overhead pool = Cost Summary total_business_overheads (map s6/s7: overhead_absorbed_cost). Support-asset cost that is not assigned reaches the groups only through the F-4 spread (A-7).

A-2  group_recovery_hours when asset hours drive: MIN(required_asset_hours, labour hours) if any labour is assigned (map s7, CM-9); with no labour assigned the MAX of the asset hours (the map does not say; not exercised by Scenario A).

A-3  Business Outcome asset-row overhead share uses SUM of the group's asset-row hours as the denominator (map s9.2 says 'group asset hours'; Cost Allocation's own assigned_asset_hours is the MAX, which would over-allocate). Settled by Scenario A group G02 (two assets, sequential).

A-4  The inner (per-source) cascade starts from each row's net profit LESS its non-productive share, and its shortfall is the group's outer deduction (naive group profit - final group profit). Map s9.5 says 'same two phases inside each group'.
A-5  Cascade boundary nodes (real_capacity_a/b.cascade) are read as the shortfall each cascade absorbs. Inferred from the snapshot (0 and 0.01), not stated by the map.

A-6  View A materials: revenue = real revenue - labour modelled - asset modelled (residual); true cost = COGS + max(business overheads - overhead assigned to groups, 0); profit floored at 0. View B materials is a peer at COGS x (1 + markup). Row modelled revenue is floored at 0 (CONFIRMED live 2026-10-17, misaligned A; owner decision F-5); the shortfall uses the unfloored residual.

A-8  RB-1b, TODAY's basis: the Rate Builder all_productive row overhead = total overhead x labour_share_percent / 100 (costAllocationRateBuilderSelectors.js L164-167). labour_share_percent is the Recovery Summary's output share of the recovery stream (80.32 on Scenario A, live 2026-10-26), NOT 100. It is taken from the app's own Cost Allocation raw dump as an INPUT (derived_checks); its own derivation (Recovery Summary suggested split, map s6) is NOT covered (gap G-7). Rate = overhead / ALL assigned labour hours. Its minimum recoverable rate adds Labour's weighted all-productive cost rate (all productive cost / all productive hours). The detail block also records the FIX CANDIDATE value (sum of the staff-type rows) so the gap is visible.

A-9  Best Case: View A ceiling = labour + asset modelled revenue only; View B adds materials at COGS x (1 + markup). scale = real revenue / combined when combined > real revenue, else NOT breached. The ceiling node value is the scale factor and is assumed to be 1.0 when not breached (trace formula text: '1 = not breached'). Implied net profit = modelled x scale - true cost when breached, else the naive net profit. Group value = sum of that group's labour and asset rows. View B materials implied = markup revenue x scale - materials true cost (not breached: view B net profit).

A-10 Business Modelling rows (map s10; buildSourceRows): achieved revenue = true cost + non-productive share + View A real-capacity net profit. Staff row id staff:<group>:<type>; an asset-driven unit (recovery hours from asset hours) also gets unit:<group> = assets + labour achieved; any other unit with assets gets assets:<group>. Materials row = materials true cost. Basis: staff = the row's revenue hours (assumed to be the app's s.hours), asset / unit = the unit's COVERED hours (0 for an asset group with no labour: CONFIRMED live 2026-10-26, Scenario B dry-hire unit; this is the F-7 gap), materials = COGS / 100. start = achieved / basis, floor = (true cost + non-productive share) / basis. Today net profit = sum of View A group real-capacity profit + materials real-capacity profit (unassigned cost is 0 under A-7). No levers are set in a stress seed, so modelled net profit = today and total effect = 0.

A-7  F-4 (owner decision 2026-10-25, built): support-asset cost not assigned to any working unit (total support-asset cost less the cost assigned across groups) is spread EVENLY across every group row and added to that group's non-productive asset cost. So Cost Allocation total = Cost Summary burden whenever every productive asset is assigned. An unassigned PRODUCTIVE asset is a blocking flag in the app, not spread; recipes must assign every productive asset.

A-12 EBIT / EBITDA table totals (map s9, businessOutcomeEbitCalculations.js; R2 fix batch 2026-10-26). Always View A. total_net_profit = today net profit (View A group real-capacity profit + materials real-capacity profit; unassigned cost is 0 under A-7). total_interest = EVERY asset's interest (the app adds a remainder row for support and unassigned assets, F-8). total_depreciation = the recipe's depreciation_annual summed over every asset copy (default none = 0), added back in full: this is the F-10b TARGET. Until F-10b is built the app adds depreciation only for assets assigned to a group, so a recipe must put depreciation_annual only on productive assets that are 100% assigned (scenario_a_depreciation does). EBIT = net profit + interest. EBITDA = EBIT + depreciation.
